children: According to a latest national poll by Focaldata, U.S. President Donald Trump's approval rating has fallen to a record low, with voters increasingly dissatisfied with his handling of the economy and cost of living. The poll found that 33% of registered voters approved of Trump's performance as president, down 3 percentage points from last month and the lowest reading since the question was first asked in May. His approval rating among Republican voters also fell by more than 2 percentage points to 72%, another record low for the survey.

title: US President Donald Trump's Approval Rating Falls to Record Low, Poll Shows
